Toroban is an atmospheric and addictive puzzle game where exploration and logic merge into a single adventure. The player will wander through an open world divided into biomes, each offering its own mechanics and types of challenges. Non-linear progression allows for solutions to be sought in any order, creating a unique rhythm.

Toroidal worlds

Each zone introduces new mechanics. In the grassy area, you master the basics — blocks, buttons, gates. In the ruins, collapsed walls reveal the outside world, where puzzles interact with each other. Five days before the verdict

Every decision you make impacts the ease of travel for residents, line congestion, and the efficiency of the entire system.

Transport network

Design begins with station placement and line layout, but gradually evolves into the complex task of organizing urban transportation. It's necessary to consider the location of residential areas and workplaces, adjust train intervals, devise convenient transfers, and avoid station congestion to encourage as many passengers as possible to choose the metro.

The data obtained helps us continually improve the network. We can monitor which routes are most popular, where delays occur, which stations become bottlenecks, and how passengers' habits change following schedule changes. Gradual optimization allows us to create an efficient transport system capable of handling ever-increasing passenger traffic.
